app.name.description: The product name, shown in the window title, the header and the about page. A brand name: never translate it.

common.back.description: Button that returns to the previous screen or step.

common.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog or form without saving anything.

common.clear.description: Button that empties a field, search or selection.

common.close.description: Button that closes a panel or dialog.

common.discard_confirm.description: Confirmation question shown when the user leaves a form that has unsaved changes.

common.done.description: Button that finishes a step or closes an editing mode after the work is saved.

common.edit.description: Button or link that opens a record for editing.

common.error.invalid_upload.description: Error shown when an uploaded file can't be read or is the wrong type.

common.error.manager_or_admin_required.description: Error shown when a cashier tries an action only a manager or an admin may do.

common.error.network.description: Error shown when a request fails because the till can't reach the server or another till.

common.error.server.description: Generic error shown when an action fails for an unexpected reason.

common.loading.description: Short status text shown while a list or panel is loading.

common.money.invalid.description: Validation message under an amount field when the input is not a valid amount. Keep both example amounts and both separators (dot and comma).

common.money.invalid_whole.description: Validation message under an amount field that accepts whole numbers only.

common.no_results.description: Empty-state text when a search finds nothing.

common.percent.invalid.description: Validation message under a percentage field. Keep both examples and both separators (dot and comma).

common.show_less.description: Toggle that collapses an expanded list or text.

common.show_more.description: Toggle that expands a shortened list or text.

common.view.description: Button or link that opens a record read-only.

import.system.ask_manager.description: Shown on the import page's 'From another till system' section to a user who may not install plugins or edit their settings: who to ask instead. Also shown when no importer is installed.

import.system.busy.description: Busy message while the till fetches products from the shop's previous till system through an importer plugin (can take minutes).

import.system.change.active.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: whether the product is active (sellable). One word, lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.barcode.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's barcode. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.category.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's category. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.name.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's name. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.price.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's selling price. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.stock.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's stock count. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.vat.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's VAT rate. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.changes.description: Import preview row detail listing which fields of an existing product the import would change. Sits in a narrow table cell: keep it short and lower case.
placeholders: comma-separated list of changed field names, e.g. 'price, stock'

import.system.col.detail.description: Column heading in the import preview table: what changes or what is wrong with the row.

import.system.col.name.description: Column heading in the import preview table: the product name.

import.system.col.result.description: Column heading in the import preview table: whether the row is new, updated, unchanged or has an issue.

import.system.col.row.description: Column heading in the import preview table: the row number from the importer.

import.system.commit_done.description: Message shown when an import from another till system has finished and the products are saved; also shown above a warning when some rows had issues.

import.system.connection.description: Accessible label read by screen readers (not visible text) for the list of an importer plugin's secret keys (API key and secret), each shown only as set or not set.

import.system.count.issues.description: Count label in an import result: rows that could not be imported because of a problem.

import.system.count.new.description: Count label in an import result: products that will be (or were) added.

import.system.count.unchanged.description: Count label in an import result: products that already match and are left as they are.

import.system.count.updated.description: Count label in an import result: existing products that will be (or were) changed.

import.system.error.bad_answer.description: Error when the importer plugin's reply can't be read; nothing was saved.

import.system.error.declined.description: Error when the importer plugin stopped and gave a reason, for example wrong API keys.
placeholders: the reason the importer plugin gave, in its own words

import.system.error.declined_silent.description: Error when the importer plugin stopped without giving a reason; points the user to the connection settings.

import.system.error.failed.description: Error when the import could not be completed for an unexpected reason; nothing was saved.

import.system.error.no_entities.description: Error when the importer plugin has not been granted permission to add products.

import.system.error.no_response.description: Error when the importer plugin did not answer in time, usually because the till is offline.

import.system.error.not_found.description: Error when the chosen importer plugin was removed while the page was open.

import.system.error.partial.description: Error when an import stopped part-way; tells the user how many products were saved and that running it again is safe.
placeholders: number of products saved before the import stopped

import.system.error.preview_failed.description: Error when the import preview could not be built.

import.system.error.refused.description: Error when the till rejected the product rows the importer plugin sent; nothing was saved.

import.system.get_importer.description: Link to the plugin store's import category, shown when no importer plugin is installed.

import.system.help.description: Explanation at the top of the 'From another till system' import section: what an importer plugin does, that preview saves nothing and that re-running is safe.

import.system.none.description: Empty state when no importer plugin for another till system is installed; says what to do next.

import.system.plugin_message.description: Shows a message the importer plugin returned, for example the name of the connected account.
placeholders: the message text the importer plugin returned

import.system.preview.description: Button that fetches products from the other till system and shows what would be imported, without saving anything.

import.system.preview_done.description: Message above the import preview: nothing is saved until the user presses Import.

import.system.run_again.description: Button that repeats an import that stopped part-way; already imported products are not duplicated.

import.system.samples.description: Heading above the table of example rows from the import preview.

import.system.settings_link.description: Link to the importer plugin's settings page, where the shop enters its API key and secret.

import.system.title.description: Heading of the import page section that imports products from another till system through an installed importer plugin.

import.welcome.system.action.description: Button on the import page's welcome card that opens the 'From another till system' section.

import.welcome.system.body.description: Text on the import page's welcome card explaining importing straight from the shop's old till system account, with a preview first.

import.welcome.system.title.description: Title of the import page's welcome card for importing from another till system.

pos.scan_choice.customer.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a customer or loyalty card. The customer's name is shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.item.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a catalog item (product). The item's name and price are shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.promo.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a promotion or discount code. The code is shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.receipt.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is the number of an earlier receipt (sale), which opens its refund. The receipt number is shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.title.description: Heading of the sale-screen chooser shown when one scanned or typed code matches more than one thing (e.g. an item and a gift voucher). It asks the cashier which one they meant.

pos.scan_choice.voucher.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a gift voucher number. The voucher number and remaining balance are shown under it.

settings.update.android.install_again.description: Android in-app update: shown on the update button (status-bar chip, Settings → Software update, the check-for-updates result) when Android's installer was opened but closed again or never came up on screen. Tapping the button opens the installer again with the app already downloaded.
